reasons: Shape alone does not decide the family; only the SSN reading is excluded by the unassigned area.

title: ITIN-shaped values within the unassigned SSN area range (description only)
rationale: Structural-only collision: IRS-issued ITINs use a 9xx area with a 7x or 8x group, so a value in the SSN-unassigned 9xx range can still identify a person under another identifier. 'Unassigned as an SSN' does not imply 'cannot identify a person'. No value is authored because an ITIN-shaped value may be real.

reasons: Which family such a value belongs to is not decided by shape alone.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: Read the IRS ITIN publication and model ITIN as its own kind if in scope.
